procedures.name: Solar Surplus Capture
procedures.description: Prioritize charging BESS when solar generation exceeds local load consumption to capture carbon-free energy.

procedures.name: Peak Demand Shaving
procedures.description: Discharge batteries to reduce site load demand during high electricity market tariff periods.

procedures.name: Market Arbitrage Trading
procedures.description: Optimize economic returns by charging the battery when prices are low/negative and discharging when prices are high.
